facts.name: The Cityfox Experience
facts.summary: Brands: Cityfox Odyssey (27-hour NYE), Cityfox Halloween Festival, Cityfox Live. Rooms: Avant Gardner / Brooklyn Mirage complex, multi-stage warehouse takeovers. Books: Melodic house & techno at headline level, unusually live-friendly — RÜFÜS DU SOL, Monolink, Stimming live have all played; supports come via agents
